none: PAS FindID 1017734: Roman coin: nummus of the House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Valentinian (364-378), Emperor right, Reece period 19, on a reddish worn oval flan. Obverse description: Bust draped diademed and cuirassed right. Reverse description: Emperor advancing right dragging captive and holding labarum. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA ROMANORVM]. Diameter: 17.3mm, Weight: 1.01gms, die axis: 6
